bio_en: Martiros Charukhjian grew up in Baku, where as a gymnasium pupil he was drawn into the ARF by Khecho, who gathered schoolboys at the cobbler Aleksan's shop and trained a group of ten of them for the life of a haiduk. He was photographed with Dro and fought in the Persian constitutional revolution alongside Yeprem. He was killed on 7 February 1909 (old style) in the battle of Alvar near Tabriz.
